title: The Legend of Korra: The Re-telling of Korra's Journey
original_title: The Legend of Korra: The Re-telling of Korra's Journey
overview: From leaving her home in the Southern Water Tribe to quickly putting her Avatar skills to the test, and finally facing Amon and the Equalists, get ready to relive the exciting adventures of Avatar Korra in this complete Book 1 recap!
